E3 mentions Al and Cr effects on corrosion resistance in HEAs but notes Al can form a porous film that enhances pitting, contradicting the premise of a stable protective Al/Cr scale. No evidence supports the behavior under reducing conditions or the efficacy of pre-oxidation for this alloy.
